newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks dip in morning, disregard BOJ tankan.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks dip in morning, disregard BOJ tankan.

text.p: Tokyo stocks slipped in early morning trade on Wednesday, showing little reaction to the Bank of Japan's "tankan" survey on short-term corporate sentiment, which was within expectations.
As of 0016 GMT, the Nikkei average was 110.01 points or 0.67 percent lower at 17,759.58. Its June futures were down 30 points at 17,820.

"There were no surprises as far as the tankan is concerned and it did not provide much direction for stocks," said Yasuo Ueki, Nikko Securities general manager. "Worries about the banking sector are still dampening the market."

The tankan survey, which is regarded as an important indicator of monetary policy, showed that Japan's major manufacturers grew slightly more positive about business conditions in March. But analysts said the results would do little to prompt an early tightening of interest rates.
